name: 06756 · Goshen, CT
findings: ZIP 06756 (Goshen) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06756 (Goshen) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
